title: pm-eng-bridgework-1on1-prep
content:
Meeting: PM <> Eng Lead 1:1 - prep notes (Priya)
Date: 2026-03-12 10:00 PT (30m)
Attendees: Priya (PM), Luca (Eng Lead) - quick sync; Diego optional
Goal: unblock Dedicated/Private rollout items, align on next two sprints for API/Console polish, surface any reliability cost tradeoffs we should escalate to GTM.

TOPLINE CONTEXT (2 sentences)
- Dedicated capacity pilot for AcmeCorp goes live mid-April; we need final autoscale policy + canary plan for model fallbacks.
- Private deployment onboarding has two blockers: KMS integration for HSM-backed keys, and audit log ingestion latency causing delays in compliance checks.

AGENDA (timeboxed)
1) Quick state check (3m) - Luca: what's hot?
2) Dedicated: autoscale + canary plan (8m) - confirm policy, rollback triggers, test matrix
3) Private: KMS & audit log blockers (8m) - what engineering effort + risk mitigation
4) Console polish: route-level cost breakdown UX (5m) - roadmap/deps
5) Action items + parking lot (6m)

PRIORITY QUESTIONS TO ASK LUCA
- Do we have confidence in the current autoscale policy for Dedicated (min-max, buffer, burst)? Any scenarios where it oscillates?
- Can we run the canary with 10% traffic + automated rollback on increased token latency > 2x baseline? How fast to detect?
- KMS: is the HSM integration blocked on vendor cert or infra changes? Is there a temporary approach (customer-managed key passthrough) we can offer for Acme?
- Audit logs: can we shard ingest to reduce tail latency? Is there a short-term fallback where we delay compliance verification but still let onboarding proceed?

NOTES / BACKGROUND (quick bullets)
- Autoscale tuning: current policy tuned for throughput; observed spike on long-context workloads causes cold-start queueing (SRE note). Link to perf dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/instances/dedicated-autoscale
- Canary plan draft in Confluence (DEPR-rolling-deploys). Need sign-off on metrics: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and cost-per-token delta.
- PR #1294 introduces continuous batching improvement that may reduce p95 by ~8% on A100s; needs load-test before enabling on Dedicated.
- Private KMS: vendor requires attestation for HSM provisioning; sequence below: vendor attestation -> infra DHCP changes -> infra security review. Currently vendor step is slow.

RISKS TO CALL OUT
- If we delay canary due to PR gating, AcmeCorp pilot timeline slips (commercial risk).
- Enabling PR1294 globally may change latency profile for short queries; need per-route canary.
- Audit log latency could block SOC sign-off; if we offer workaround we must document residual risk for Legal.

PROPOSED DECISIONS / ASKS (what I want from Luca)
- Confirm we can commit to autoscale policy and provide rollback runbook by 2026-03-18 (owner: Luca).
- Approve running canary with the batching PR enabled for Dedicated but gated to a single machine pool for 2 days (owner: Luca + SRE).
- For KMS, provide an ETA for vendor attestation and a short-term passthrough option by 2026-03-20 (owner: Diego).

DRAFT ACTION ITEMS (capture during meeting)
- Luca: produce rollback runbook + checklist (due 2026-03-18) - include detection thresholds and automated rollback playbook.
- Luca + SRE (Anika): schedule canary run, prepare load test plan, toggle gating in deployment pipeline (due 2026-03-17).
- Diego: follow up with KMS vendor on attestation timeline and propose temporary key passthrough flow (due 2026-03-20).
- Priya: update Acme onboarding doc with known constraints + proposed mitigations; send customer note draft for legal review (due 2026-03-15).

PARKING LOT / ITEMS TO FOLLOW UP LATER
- Console UX: route-level cost breakdown prototype — link to mock: https://figma.com/file/console-costs-proto (assign to UX in next sprint).
- Consider adding a "dedicated-safe-mode" flag that disables PR1294 optimizations per route for predictable latency profiles.
- Evaluate short-term audit-log buffering that preserves integrity but delays visibility for compliance tools by <15m.

NOTES TO SELF (private, terse)
- Keep tone calm with Acme — they worry about predictability. Avoid promising immediate HSM finality.
- If Luca pushes back on canary speed, ask for an explicit test plan and phasing; escalate to Eng Dir if blocked by resourcing.
- Remember to update the rollout timeline in the commercial tracker (sheet id in CS: Acme-onboarding-2026).

LAST-MINUTE REMINDERS
- Bring up cost-savings ask from finance: can we quantify delta if we enable PR1294 only on batch-heavy routes? CFO wants a ballpark by next week.
- Check PR #1294 tests on power9 vs a100 — ensure we note arch differences.

EXTRA LINKS / REFERENCES
- Load test results (staging): https://perf.redwood.ai/runs/2026-02-25
- Jira: INFR-2345 (autoscale oscillation)
- GH: runtime PR 1294 review comments: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1294

End of prep doc.

-- Priya
